regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad, precious-metals-led rotation with Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners at ranks 1-2, both eligible and non-crowded, with 8 of 16 themes eligible and a thin 0.034 margin between leader and challenger. Gate_helps is true on this market's history, so the absolute-trend eligibility gate is the one validated risk-control leg; momentum ranks are a focus lens only.
emerging_watch: Watching Uranium & Nuclear (rank 8, ineligible). It has the cleanest breadth among losers (0.75) and a negative crowding_z (-0.83) with a mean-revert Hurst tag. The condition that would retire this watch is XBM.TO (base metals proxy) losing trend-gate eligibility while Uranium gains eligibility and enters the top-5 ranked score.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: The leader theme is eligible via the validated absolute-trend gate, has full breadth (1.0) and moderate durability (0.69) with no crowding flag. The lean is a trend-continuation preference grounded in the one validated leg — the trend gate — not a momentum return forecast.
theses.dissent: The leader-challenger margin is only 0.034, effectively a dead heat; cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so leadership says nothing about forward relative return. Hurst is 'mixed', not cleanly trending.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (proxy) underperforms SP/TSX over a rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is eligible via the trend gate with the highest durability bar in the set (0.73) and full breadth, and sits essentially tied with the leader. The lean is a continuation preference supported by the trend-gate eligibility and durability leg.
theses.dissent: Shares the same proxy (XGD.TO) as the leader, so the two rows are near-duplicates of the same precious-metals exposure; ranking them separately inflates apparent breadth. Hurst is 'mixed', weakening any clean-trend read.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms SP/TSX by 5% over a rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers remains trend-gate eligible, but it carries the only crowding flag in the top ranks (crowding_z 1.29, crowded=true) with a durability bar (0.68) that is not superior to the precious-metals leaders. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only, expressed here as a relative underweight preference against the cleaner, non-crowded leaders — not a fade or short.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge and must not be treated as a sell; the theme is still trend-gate eligible and has solid breadth. Energy could simply keep working on commodity strength.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO outperforms XGD.TO by 5% over a rolling 20-day window before the 30-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
